budget.rationale: Conversation history, workspace state, shortcuts, provider configuration, and sender-owned snippets share the scenario database; 2 GiB bounds unexpected growth without making durable operator data reclaimable.

web-console-db.rationale: Primary durable SQLite database owned by Web Console.

web-console-db-wal.rationale: SQLite write-ahead log sidecar for the durable Web Console database.

web-console-db-shm.rationale: SQLite shared-memory sidecar for the durable Web Console database.

budget.rationale: Recovery snapshots preserve operator data across hardening and repair operations; the ceiling detects runaway snapshot accumulation without authorizing automatic deletion.

recovery-snapshots.rationale: Protected SQLite recovery copies created before potentially destructive repair.

budget.rationale: Retain the most recent deployment evidence for operational review.

deployment-report.rationale: Lifecycle deployment evidence written beneath the scenario data root.

budget.rationale: Run metadata supports recovery and attribution for programmatic sessions and follows the transcript review window.

routed-agent-runs.rationale: Run metadata created by bounded agent-manager operations routed through Web Console's scenario storage lease.

budget.rationale: The routed Ed25519 keypair is a small stable secret; this bound catches unrelated writes without rotating identity.

routed-control-plane-keys.rationale: Control-plane signing identity created inside Web Console's routed storage boundary.

budget.rationale: The routed agent identity secret is a single small stable key; this bound detects unrelated content without rotating identity.

routed-agent-identity.rationale: Agent identity secret created inside Web Console's routed storage boundary.

session-rollouts.rationale: Per-session agent rollout transcripts are durable user work and remain available for a 30-day review window. Runtime directories under this tree are links to the shared agent home after launch-time provisioning.

budget.rationale: Retain session transcripts for 30 days for user recovery; owner cleanup protects active sessions.

agent-runtime.rationale: Regenerable agent runtime state is isolated from durable rollouts when a native agent cannot use the shared user home; normal launches link caches and runtime directories to that shared home.

budget.rationale: Fallback runtime state is disposable and may be reclaimed after the same review window without affecting rollout transcripts.

uploads.rationale: User-provided attachments are written beneath the cache-class upload root and are owned by web-console for request-scoped cleanup.

storage.rationale: The session tree is owner-managed durable state; cleanup is delegated to web-console so active sessions remain protected.

ollama.description: Local LLM provider for AI command generation (primary; falls back to OpenRouter)
ollama.degraded_behavior: AI generation falls back to OpenRouter when Ollama is unavailable

openrouter.description: Cloud LLM provider (BYOK) for AI command generation; used as the fallback when Ollama is unavailable. Model selection resolves through resource-openrouter policy roles.
openrouter.degraded_behavior: AI generation is unavailable only if both Ollama and OpenRouter are unreachable; OpenRouter requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

audio-tools.runtime_only_rationale: web-console reaches audio-tools through its scenario resolver and audioports client boundary; the dependency is a separately orchestrated service and is not linked as an in-process implementation dependency.
audio-tools.description: All audio capabilities (TTS synthesis, voice listing, summarization, STT/transcription, speaker verification, wake word) flow through audio-tools via audioports.Remote* and the shared browser capture package. web-console contains zero audio synthesis or transcription code.
audio-tools.degraded_behavior: Terminal workspace boots without audio-tools. Voice, TTS, summarization, speaker verification, and wake word features show degraded/unavailable until audio-tools is reachable, then recover on the next lazy resolution or capability refresh.

vrooli-bridge.runtime_only_rationale: web-console reaches vrooli-bridge through the configured Bridge URL and bridge session transport; the dependency is an externally orchestrated service boundary rather than an in-process import.
vrooli-bridge.description: Optional remote terminal capability. web-console uses the bridge session transport when a Bridge URL and enrolled node are configured.
vrooli-bridge.degraded_behavior: Local terminal sessions remain available; remote targets show bridge_url_missing or another typed capability reason until vrooli-bridge is configured.
